title: Senior Microsoft Teams Specialist
description:
Come to one of the biggest IT Services companies in the world!! Here you can transform your career!

Why to join TCS? Here at TCS we believe that people make the difference, that's why we live a culture of unlimited learning full of opportunities for improvement and mutual development. The ideal scenario to expand ideas through the right tools, contributing to our success in a collaborative environment.

We are looking for Senior Microsoft Teams Specialist who wants to learn and transform his career.

In this role you will:


Administer and optimize Microsoft Teams, including channels, policies, integrations, and APIs.

Automate processes and recommend engineering improvements.

Monitor alerts, analyze root causes, and implement solutions.

Work with PowerShell, MS Graph, and application management in Teams.

Test new features and implement changes securely.

What we're looking for:

Strong experience with Microsoft Teams, M365, and integrations.

Proficiency in PowerShell/MS Graph.

Experience managing applications, APIs, and automation.

Knowledge of RCA (Root Cause Analysis) and service improvement.

Fluent in English


What can you expect from us?

• Professional development and constant evolution of your skills, always in line with your interests.

• Opportunities to work outside Brazil

• A collaborative, diverse and innovative environment that encourages teamwork.

What do we offer?

  • TCS Benefits – Brazil:
  • Health insurance
  • Dental Plan
  • Life insurance
  • Transportation vouchers
  • Meal/Food Voucher
  • Childcare assistance
  • Gympass
  • TCS Cares – free 0800 that provides psychological assistance (24 hrs/day), legal, social and financial assistance to associates
  • Partnership with SESC
  • Reimbursement of Certifications
  • Free TCS Learning Portal – Online courses and live training
  • International experience opportunity
  • Discount Partnership with Universities and Language Schools
  • Bring Your Buddy – By referring people you become eligible to receive a bonus for each hire
  • TCS Gems – Recognition for performance
  • Xcelerate – Free Mentoring Career Platform

At TATA Consultancy Services we promote an inclusive culture, we always work for equity. This applies to Gender, People with Disabilities, LGBTQIA+, Religion, Race, Ethnicity. All our opportunities are based on these principles. We think of different actions of inclusion and social responsibility, in order to build a TCS that respects individuality. Come to be a TCSer!

title: Senior Microsoft Teams Specialist
description:
Come to one of the biggest IT Services companies in the world!! Here you can transform your career!

Why to join TCS? Here at TCS we believe that people make the difference, that's why we live a culture of unlimited learning full of opportunities for improvement and mutual development. The ideal scenario to expand ideas through the right tools, contributing to our success in a collaborative environment.

We are looking for Senior Microsoft Teams Specialist who wants to learn and transform his career.

In this role you will:


Administer and optimize Microsoft Teams, including channels, policies, integrations, and APIs.

Automate processes and recommend engineering improvements.

Monitor alerts, analyze root causes, and implement solutions.

Work with PowerShell, MS Graph, and application management in Teams.

Test new features and implement changes securely.

What we're looking for:

Strong experience with Microsoft Teams, M365, and integrations.

Proficiency in PowerShell/MS Graph.

Experience managing applications, APIs, and automation.

Knowledge of RCA (Root Cause Analysis) and service improvement.

Fluent in English


What can you expect from us?

• Professional development and constant evolution of your skills, always in line with your interests.

• Opportunities to work outside Brazil

• A collaborative, diverse and innovative environment that encourages teamwork.

What do we offer?

  • TCS Benefits – Brazil:
  • Health insurance
  • Dental Plan
  • Life insurance
  • Transportation vouchers
  • Meal/Food Voucher
  • Childcare assistance
  • Gympass
  • TCS Cares – free 0800 that provides psychological assistance (24 hrs/day), legal, social and financial assistance to associates
  • Partnership with SESC
  • Reimbursement of Certifications
  • Free TCS Learning Portal – Online courses and live training
  • International experience opportunity
  • Discount Partnership with Universities and Language Schools
  • Bring Your Buddy – By referring people you become eligible to receive a bonus for each hire
  • TCS Gems – Recognition for performance

  • Conhecimento em Docker e desenvolvimento com containers;
  • Experiência com entrega contínua (CI/CD) e feature toggle ;
  • Vivência em ambientes ágeis e colaboração com múltiplos times.


Desejável

  • Conhecimento em TDD e BDD ;
  • Experiência com Kubernetes ;
  • Experiência com Microsoft Azure ;

  • Interesse em práticas de DevOps e automação de deploy.

title: Senior Microsoft Teams Specialist
description:
Come to one of the biggest IT Services companies in the world!! Here you can transform your career!

Why to join TCS? Here at TCS we believe that people make the difference, that's why we live a culture of unlimited learning full of opportunities for improvement and mutual development. The ideal scenario to expand ideas through the right tools, contributing to our success in a collaborative environment.

We are looking for Senior Microsoft Teams Specialist who wants to learn and transform his career.

In this role you will:


Administer and optimize Microsoft Teams, including channels, policies, integrations, and APIs.

Automate processes and recommend engineering improvements.

Monitor alerts, analyze root causes, and implement solutions.

Work with PowerShell, MS Graph, and application management in Teams.

Test new features and implement changes securely.

What we're looking for:

Strong experience with Microsoft Teams, M365, and integrations.

Proficiency in PowerShell/MS Graph.

Experience managing applications, APIs, and automation.

Knowledge of RCA (Root Cause Analysis) and service improvement.

Fluent in English


What can you expect from us?

• Professional development and constant evolution of your skills, always in line with your interests.

• Opportunities to work outside Brazil

• A collaborative, diverse and innovative environment that encourages teamwork.

What do we offer?

  • TCS Benefits – Brazil:
  • Health insurance
  • Dental Plan
  • Life insurance
  • Transportation vouchers
  • Meal/Food Voucher
  • Childcare assistance
  • Gympass
  • TCS Cares – free 0800 that provides psychological assistance (24 hrs/day), legal, social and financial assistance to associates
  • Partnership with SESC
  • Reimbursement of Certifications
  • Free TCS Learning Portal – Online courses and live training
  • International experience opportunity
  • Discount Partnership with Universities and Language Schools
  • Bring Your Buddy – By referring people you become eligible to receive a bonus for each hire
  • TCS Gems – Recognition for performance
  • Xcelerate – Free Mentoring Career Platform

At TATA Consultancy Services we promote an inclusive culture, we always work for equity. This applies to Gender, People with Disabilities, LGBTQIA+, Religion, Race, Ethnicity. All our opportunities are based on these principles. We think of different actions of inclusion and social responsibility, in order to build a TCS that respects individuality. Come to be a TCSer!

title: Project and Facilities Manager
description:
A day in the life:

The project and facilities manager of AFF (American Fruits and Flavors) Brazil is responsible for ensuring the warehouse conversion project is completed to AFF standards and to what our contractor agreement outlines. You will ensure the manufacturing facility expansions, equipment installations, and renovations, are maintained within strict timelines and budgets while ensuring compliance with all safety, environmental, and building codes.


Key project management responsibilities include managing project scope, budget, schedule, reviewing construction material specifications and risk; coordinating with internal teams and external contractors; overseeing construction and maintenance activities; and ensuring all operations are safe and efficient for manufacturing processes. This role will be required to provide status reports and any deviations or questions back to key stakeholders from the AFF corporate location.


Key facilities management responsibilities include overseeing the building's daily operations, ensuring its physical infrastructure, safety, and services (like maintenance, cleaning, security, door access, CCTV, Networking infrastructure (IT) and space utilization) meet health/safety standards. This will include managing staff and third-party vendors, coordinating renovations and repairs, handling budgets and contracts, ensuring compliance with regulations, and optimizing space for efficiency. We’re looking for someone who can maintain a positive work atmosphere by behaving and communicating in ways that foster good relationships with employees, co-workers and managers, while achieving performance standards. This person will partner closely with US based project manager to ensure alignment between AFF facilities.


ESSENTIAL JOB DUTIES:

Project Planning & Management:

Ensure comprehensive project plans, scope, budget, and schedules for manufacturing-related facility projects are being met.

Define project requirements and manage the allocation of resources and labor.

Monitor project execution, track progress, and implement corrective actions to stay on schedule and within budget.

Sign off on all installation to ensure it meets defined specifications.

Contractor Management:

Manage project finances, including budget development, forecasting, and cost control.

Approve invoices, manage change orders, and monitor overall project spending.

Select, coordinate, and manage external contractors and vendors to ensure quality and cost-effectiveness.

Safety, Compliance, & Operations:

Ensure all facilities adhere to federal, state, and local codes, as well as industry regulations.

Stakeholder Coordination:

Serve as a liaison between internal departments, senior management, and external stakeholders.

Communicate project status, risks, and issues to relevant parties, fostering effective working relationships.

Maintenance & Operations: Ensure the building's heating, cooling, plumbing, and other critical systems are functioning correctly and safely.

Safety & Security: Implement and oversee security procedures, conduct safety inspections, and ensure the facility complies with all health, safety, and environmental regulations.

Space Management: Maximize the efficient use of the company's space and equipment, coordinating renovations and refurbishments as needed.

Vendor & Contractor Management: Hire, supervise, and manage third-party vendors for services such as cleaning, landscaping, repairs, and maintenance.

Strategic Planning: Contribute to long-term strategic planning for facility maintenance, growth, and improvements.


REQUIREMENTS:


Fluent in English and Portuguese (both written and verbal)

Project Management Expertise: Experience managing three (minimum) similar new build and processing installation projects. Proficiency in project planning tools, scheduling software, and risk management techniques.

Technical Knowledge: Understanding of building systems (mechanical, electrical, structural) and food manufacturing processes.

Financial Acumen: Experience in budgeting, cost management, and invoice processing.

Regulatory Knowledge: Familiarity with environmental regulations, food manufacturing licensing and permitting and construction codes.

Leadership & Communication: Ability to manage cross-functional teams, resolve conflicts, and communicate effectively with diverse groups.

Problem-Solving: Strong analytical skills to assess situations, identify issues, and implement solutions.

title: Consultor/a em Administração Contratual (Contrato Temporário)
description:
Estamos com uma oportunidade de Consultor/a em Administração Contratual para atuar em sob contrato temporário e regime híbrido em uma de nossas obras na região do Rio Grande do Sul/RS . Este/a profissional garantirá a correta gestão dos contratos em projetos de construção civil, assegurando conformidade legal, mitigação de riscos e maximização de resultados financeiros , tendo estas principais atribuições:


  • Analisar e interpretar contratos de obras e serviços, identificando riscos e oportunidades;
  • Acompanhar a execução contratual, propondo medidas corretivas e preventivas;
  • Elaborar notificações, aditivos, termos de encerramento e demais documentos contratuais;
  • Apoiar tecnicamente a equipe de obras na gestão de escopo, prazos, custos e compliance contratual;
  • Participar de reuniões com clientes, fornecedores e subcontratados para alinhamento contratual;
  • Realizar interface com o jurídico para suporte em disputas, mediações e arbitragens;
  • Garantir o cumprimento das obrigações contratuais e legais, incluindo cláusulas de compliance, seguros, garantias e licenças;
  • Utilizar corretamente a documentação que integra a concorrência (carta convite, edital de licitação, perguntas/consultas, leis de contratação pública, etc.) durante a etapa de conquista;
  • Assegurar o cumprimento de todos os deveres e obrigações contratuais, com amplo domínio dos documentos envolvidos (contrato, proposta técnica/econômica, aditivos, leis, normas, seguros e fianças);
  • Elaborar, em conjunto com outras áreas, documentação contratual robusta (cartas, e-mails, diários de obra, relatórios, cronogramas, etc.), respeitando os parâmetros e prazos contratuais e mantendo o arquivo do projeto organizado;
  • Quando cabível, elaborar e sustentar reivindicações (claims) e aditivos junto ao cliente, preservando o equilíbrio contratual.


Perfil Requerido:

  • Formação Superior completa em Engenharia, Direito, Administração ou áreas correlatas;
  • Desejável Pós-Graduação ou MBA em Gestão de Contratos, Direito Contratual ou Gerenciamento de Projetos;
  • Experiência em projetos de infraestrutura pesada e/ou obras industriais na área de Administração Contratual;
  • Sólidos conhecimentos da Legislação aplicável (Lei de Licitações, Contratos Privados, Normas Técnicas);
  • Forte habilidade de negociação, comunicação clara e visão analítica;
  • Dominar as diversas estruturas de modalidades contratuais utilizadas nos mercados mais competitivos mundialmente (Preços Unitários, preço global, LSTK, Aliança, EPCM, entre outros.
  • Disponibilidade / mobilidade para atuar sob contrato temporário, em regime híbrido, na região do Rio Grande do Sul/RS



Sobre a Odebrecht:


A Odebrecht Engenharia & Construção é uma empresa que presta serviços nos segmentos de construção civil pesada e construção, montagem e manutenção de empreendimentos industriais, sediada no Brasil e atende além deste país, outros quatro mercados: Brasil, Angola e Estados Unidos. Composta por mais de 20 mil Integrantes, a Odebrecht gera oportunidades de trabalho para as populações locais e contribui para o desenvolvimento sustentável de cada região, atuando nas seguintes áreas:


✔ Transporte e Logística

✔ Energia

✔ Saneamento

✔ Engenharia Industrial

✔ Desenvolvimento Urbano e Edificações



Nossa Cultura:


A Nossa Cultura é um conjunto de princípios, conceitos e critérios, com foco na educação e no trabalho, que provê os fundamentos éticos, morais e conceituais para a atuação dos integrantes do Grupo. Valorizamos potencialidades do ser humano, como a disposição para servir, a capacidade e o desejo de evoluir e a vontade de superar resultados. Acreditamos, com convicção e determinação, que a prática da Cultura Odebrecht e das nossas políticas, com atuação ética, íntegra e transparente e o compromisso em promover a diversidade, nos fortalecem e aumentam a nossa competitividade, no rumo da sobrevivência, do crescimento e da perpetuidade.

title: Country Manager (Legal, Brasil)
description:
Hello!



We are looking for an experienced and proactive Country Manager to join our global legal team and lead enforcement efforts in Brazil.


You’ll work closely with global legal and business teams, directly protecting the rights of some of the world's most recognized brands.


This is a role with complete ownership for driving our expansion in Brazil.


We need a manager with a legal background who knows how to create processes from scratch in a startup environment, rather than an established corporation. The ideal candidate will effectively lead people, design and scale operations, and be highly results-driven.


Who are we?



BrandMonitor is a global legal-tech company focused on the protection of intellectual property rights across the world. We proudly represent over 450 international brands across industries like fashion, luxury goods, electronics, and more — in their fight against counterfeiting and IP violations.

Our legal operations span Europe, Asia, MENA and Latin America , and we are now expanding our legal team in China .



What you will do:



  • Be responsible for meeting the revenue plan and the target number of enforcement actions (purchases, claims, and lawsuits);
  • Achieve operational profitability for the project;
  • Rebuild the team, organize rapid onboarding, and ensure the team achieves target performance indicators;
  • Develop operational and hiring regulations for project scaling (increasing the number of protected brands, successful cases, and compensation amounts);
  • Negotiate with counterfeit sellers and ensure compliance with settlement agreements and court decisions;
  • Organize regular, predictable seizures of counterfeit goods with law enforcement agencies in the region;
  • Ensure the legality of all activities and provide accurate reporting to the government and the head office.



What we expect from you:


  • Degree in Law / Experience in a management position at a law firm;
  • Project management experience 2-3 years;
  • Experience in building processes from scratch;
  • Knowledge of Intellectual Property - an advantage;
  • Leadership, responsibility, decision-making ability, multitasking skills;
  • Fluent in Portuguese and English B2.



What We Offer


  • Work with top-tier global clients and international teams;
  • Competitive salary;
  • Opportunity to lead and shape legal operations in the region;
  • Remote-first setup with flexibility;
  • Real impact on the global fight against counterfeit trade.
  • We’re building the future of IP protection — fast, smart and global.



Join us at BrandMonitor and help us grow stronger by hiring the people who’ll make it happen.

title: SAP Technical support leader (ABAP/BASIS)
description:
You’re purpose driven. Growth minded. Ready to stretch your potential. That’s the spirit of the community you’ll find at Orbia: where the purpose to advance life around the world drives our global team of over 23,000 every single day.

From creating solutions to deliver clean water, secure food supplies and reliable information to steering material advances that power the future of green and smart cities, transportation, and healthcare, we never settle for “good enough” when there’s an opportunity to make life better. Where purpose comes to life, it changes lives. This is what we live for.


Fluor & Energy Materials , an Orbia business, is looking for a SAP Technical support leader (ABAP/BASIS) to be based at México, Colombia or Brazil !


Job Summary/ Purpose

Our team, the Service Delivery Management for Global Applications, is responsible to ensure operational continuity of Orbia’s Global Business Applications like SAP ECC, S/4, CFIN, SuccessFactors and others. The support of these applications is under a Managed Service partner, and our role is to supervise and ensure that this service is delivered to Orbia’s standards of quality and following our processes and policies. This role will have a specific responsibility over initiatives that require Developments in those applications, by supporting and monitoring the service of the AMS (Application Managed Support) partners, defining and enforcing best practices and security standards, and providing operational support when needed (e.g. in case of escalations, issues with in-house developed apps or legacy apps).


Main Responsibilities

  • Creation of best practices and operational processes related to Application Development in SAP ECC and S/4 (ABAP, BTP, Fiori).
  • On a general note and not restricted to Development initiatives: Being a point of contact for Orbia’s companies located in LATAM, guiding them through our Service Delivery Model when needed and ensuring that they get the right support on time.
  • Provide operational support (in collaboration with the AMS partner) to application/integrations developed in-house or other developments in Legacy Applications when needed. Provide ideas to the Application Solution leads for those Legacy apps/integrations to be included the target architecture roadmap. Support their transition to target architecture when needed (e.g. from a local application to S/4 BTP portals or apps).
  • Ensure that developments or customizations in the S/4 applications are done following the Digital Decoupling strategy as defined by the Orbia Global Applications team.
  • Support and drive automation initiatives where possible, with a final goal of incident reduction and self-service (e.g. self-healing, monitoring and alert systems, automation of standard requests, etc.).
  • Drive and encourage new ways of working in collaboration with the AMS partner, for example Devops or Scrum.
  • Participation in the major incident process when needed, for Americas’ applications/time zones.
  • Participation in CAB or coordination with IT Service Desk meetings when needed.


Minimum Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in computer science or related
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English and Spanish.


Knowledge/ Experience Required

  • Good understanding of SAP ECC and S/4 Technical and Development functionalities (BTP, Basis, ABAP, Fiori/JAVA, etc.).
  • Good knowledge of ITIL framework.
  • Ability to take on the above-mentioned responsibilities with a constructive and collaborative approach.
  • Passion for Service standardization and improvement.
  • Excellent people skills, ability to manage escalations from business colleagues from all levels of the organization.
  • Able to work under pressure and meet deadlines when needed.
  • Able to manage and prioritize tasks and time efficiently, and coordinate efforts with external partners in an effective manner.
  • Able to demonstrate initiative and a proactive approach to daily tasks.


Behaviors that can help you succeed at Orbia:

  • Develop yourself & Others
  • Foster Collaboration & Inclusion
  • Drive Results
  • Provide Vision & Direction


We welcome purpose-driven dreamers, doers, and builders, recognizing that it takes difference to make a difference. If you’re ready to bring your skills, talents, and perspective to moving your career, the company, people, and the planet forward, we’d like to hear from you.

We believe that every voice matters; every community deserves respect; and every challenge is an opportunity and united by empathy, we are stronger for our different perspectives. We are dedicated to building a more diverse, inclusive, and equitable workplace that supports the needs of all our employees regardless of their role, location, identity, and background.

  • Good knowledge of ITIL framework.
  • Ability to take on the above-mentioned responsibilities with a constructive and collaborative approach.
  • Passion for Service standardization and improvement.
  • Excellent people skills, ability to manage escalations from business colleagues from all levels of the organization.
  • Able to work under pressure and meet deadlines when needed.
  • Able to manage and prioritize tasks and time efficiently, and coordinate efforts with external partners in an effective manner.
  • Able to demonstrate initiative and a proactive approach to daily tasks.


Behaviors that can help you succeed at Orbia:

  • Develop yourself & Others
  • Foster Collaboration & Inclusion
  • Drive Results
  • Provide Vision & Direction


We welcome purpose-driven dreamers, doers, and builders, recognizing that it takes difference to make a difference. If you’re ready to bring your skills, talents, and perspective to moving your career, the company, people, and the planet forward, we’d like to hear from you.

We believe that every voice matters; every community deserves respect; and every challenge is an opportunity and united by empathy, we are stronger for our different perspectives. We are dedicated to building a more diverse, inclusive, and equitable workplace that supports the needs of all our employees regardless of their role, location, identity, and background.

title: Corporate Sponsorship Sales
description:
Vendas de Patrocínios / Estandes para nossos Congressos de Inteligência Artificial, Tecnologia e Negócios América Digital, realizados no Chile, México e Estados Unidos (

Profissionais da área comercial com mais de 4 anos de experiência em vendas B2B de patrocínios / sponsorships / estandes para congressos e feiras. Podem estar baseados no México, Colômbia, Brasil, Argentina, Uruguai, Panamá ou Miami, Estados Unidos.


Quais serão suas responsabilidades e funções?

  • Conduzir o processo integral de vendas B2B de patrocínios / sponsorships / estandes para nossos congressos e feiras, estabelecendo conexões diretas com C-Levels (Country Managers, Diretores de Vendas, Marketing) das 2000 principais empresas tecnológicas globais e locais.
  • Superar metas de vendas, com foco em garantir patrocínios das principais empresas de tecnologia para nossos congressos e feiras.
  • Gerenciar e cultivar relações sólidas com clientes existentes, garantindo uma experiência contínua e satisfatória.
  • Implementar estratégias para assegurar a retenção e renovação de contas-chave na carteira, transformando clientes em contas estratégicas, ampliando negócios por meio de upselling e cross-selling.
  • Identificar oportunidades de crescimento nas contas atribuídas, antecipando e atendendo às necessidades em constante mudança dos clientes.
  • Desenvolver planos e estratégias para ampliar a participação e maximizar o valor de cada conta.
  • Explorar ativamente novas oportunidades de negócios, identificando clientes potenciais e setores estratégicos.


Requisitos

  • Capacidade comprovada de vender e negociar em inglês.
  • Perfil hunter, com habilidades de prospecção, busca ativa de oportunidades, proatividade, autonomia, resiliência, aprendizado rápido e forte orientação para resultados.
  • Excelentes habilidades de comunicação oral e escrita, além de sólidas competências de negociação.
  • Disponibilidade e recursos para trabalhar em tempo integral no modelo home office.
  • Mais de 4 anos de experiência em vendas B2B de intangíveis, patrocínios, sponsorships, estandes.
  • Experiência em negociação com executivos C-Levels, VPs e gerentes de marketing regionais de grandes empresas tecnológicas da região e globais.
  • Familiaridade com conceitos de transformação digital, TICs, Big Data, software, IoT, e-commerce e marketing digital.
  • Nível intermediário-avançado em CRM, Microsoft Office e softwares de produtividade em vendas.


O que oferecemos? Razões para se juntar à nossa equipe

  • Trabalho 100% remoto.
  • Salário base competitivo + as melhores comissões do mercado.
  • Cultura de trabalho colaborativa, ambiente multicultural com profissionais de diferentes países.
  • Fazer parte de uma empresa em constante crescimento.
  • Colaborar e aprender junto a profissionais e especialistas renomados.
  • Estar na vanguarda dos processos de vendas B2B e negociação.


Sobre nós

Através dos nossos congressos no Chile, México e Estados Unidos ( somos o ponto de encontro entre fornecedores globais e locais de soluções tecnológicas em Inteligência Artificial, Cloud, Big Data, IoT, Indústria 4.0, Telecomunicações, Software, Fintech, Web3, e-commerce, Marketing Digital e CEOs, CIOs, CTOs, CMOs, CDOs, CISOs, CFOs, líderes de negócios, inovação e transformação digital de operadoras, bancos, varejo, indústrias (manufatura, energia, petróleo e gás, mineração, agroindústria, utilities) e autoridades governamentais, ajudando-os a acelerar sua transformação digital e a migrar a economia dos países para uma economia digital.

Através do America Digital News TV ( somos o principal canal de TV e mídia online focado em notícias nas áreas de Inteligência Artificial, Inovação, Tecnologia, Negócios e Transformação Digital, alcançando atualmente mais de 145.000 assinantes.


Nossa missão

Através dos nossos congressos e meio online, ser o maior ecossistema de networking, capacitação e informação nas áreas de IA, Tecnologia, Transformação Digital e Negócios.


No momento da candidatura, responder às seguintes perguntas e enviar para:

  • Você possui um espaço de home office? (Espaço privado onde possa fechar a porta, trabalhar sem interrupções, horário integral, boa conexão à internet).
  • Você é um vendedor de vendas B2B e consultivas? Explique por quê.
  • Qual é sua experiência em vendas de intangíveis B2B, como vendas de patrocínios para congressos ou eventos?
  • Quantos anos de experiência você tem em vendas B2B? Especifique onde e detalhe sua experiência.
  • Quais foram seus resultados de vendas em 2022, 2023 e 2024? Detalhe o quê, quem, quanto e como.
  • Qual é o seu nível de domínio do Microsoft Office e CRMs? Quais CRMs já utilizou? Classifique de 1 a 7.
  • Descreva três pontos fortes e três pontos fracos. Você se considera um vendedor nato? Possui perfil comercial? Explique por quê.
  • Quais treinamentos realizou em vendas B2B, vendas consultivas e negociação? Detalhe.
  • O que está fazendo atualmente? Qual é sua disponibilidade?
  • Classifique seu nível de inglês de 1 a 10. Possui nível C1 (9)?
  • Quais são suas expectativas salariais? Informar fixo e variável.
  • Revise e indique como você pode contribuir para os objetivos comerciais de venda de patrocínios para o Congresso América Digital e para a venda do nosso meio America Digital News TV (

CI/CD pipelines

AWS

title: SAP Technical support leader (ABAP/BASIS)
description:
You’re purpose driven. Growth minded. Ready to stretch your potential. That’s the spirit of the community you’ll find at Orbia: where the purpose to advance life around the world drives our global team of over 23,000 every single day.

From creating solutions to deliver clean water, secure food supplies and reliable information to steering material advances that power the future of green and smart cities, transportation, and healthcare, we never settle for “good enough” when there’s an opportunity to make life better. Where purpose comes to life, it changes lives. This is what we live for.


Fluor & Energy Materials , an Orbia business, is looking for a SAP Technical support leader (ABAP/BASIS) to be based at México, Colombia or Brazil !


Job Summary/ Purpose

Our team, the Service Delivery Management for Global Applications, is responsible to ensure operational continuity of Orbia’s Global Business Applications like SAP ECC, S/4, CFIN, SuccessFactors and others. The support of these applications is under a Managed Service partner, and our role is to supervise and ensure that this service is delivered to Orbia’s standards of quality and following our processes and policies. This role will have a specific responsibility over initiatives that require Developments in those applications, by supporting and monitoring the service of the AMS (Application Managed Support) partners, defining and enforcing best practices and security standards, and providing operational support when needed (e.g. in case of escalations, issues with in-house developed apps or legacy apps).


Main Responsibilities

  • Creation of best practices and operational processes related to Application Development in SAP ECC and S/4 (ABAP, BTP, Fiori).
  • On a general note and not restricted to Development initiatives: Being a point of contact for Orbia’s companies located in LATAM, guiding them through our Service Delivery Model when needed and ensuring that they get the right support on time.
  • Provide operational support (in collaboration with the AMS partner) to application/integrations developed in-house or other developments in Legacy Applications when needed. Provide ideas to the Application Solution leads for those Legacy apps/integrations to be included the target architecture roadmap. Support their transition to target architecture when needed (e.g. from a local application to S/4 BTP portals or apps).
  • Ensure that developments or customizations in the S/4 applications are done following the Digital Decoupling strategy as defined by the Orbia Global Applications team.
  • Support and drive automation initiatives where possible, with a final goal of incident reduction and self-service (e.g. self-healing, monitoring and alert systems, automation of standard requests, etc.).
  • Drive and encourage new ways of working in collaboration with the AMS partner, for example Devops or Scrum.
  • Participation in the major incident process when needed, for Americas’ applications/time zones.
  • Participation in CAB or coordination with IT Service Desk meetings when needed.


Minimum Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in computer science or related
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English and Spanish.


Knowledge/ Experience Required

  • Good understanding of SAP ECC and S/4 Technical and Development functionalities (BTP, Basis, ABAP, Fiori/JAVA, etc.).
  • Good knowledge of ITIL framework.
  • Ability to take on the above-mentioned responsibilities with a constructive and collaborative approach.
  • Passion for Service standardization and improvement.
  • Excellent people skills, ability to manage escalations from business colleagues from all levels of the organization.
  • Able to work under pressure and meet deadlines when needed.
  • Able to manage and prioritize tasks and time efficiently, and coordinate efforts with external partners in an effective manner.
  • Able to demonstrate initiative and a proactive approach to daily tasks.


Behaviors that can help you succeed at Orbia:

  • Develop yourself & Others
  • Foster Collaboration & Inclusion
  • Drive Results
  • Provide Vision & Direction


We welcome purpose-driven dreamers, doers, and builders, recognizing that it takes difference to make a difference. If you’re ready to bring your skills, talents, and perspective to moving your career, the company, people, and the planet forward, we’d like to hear from you.

We believe that every voice matters; every community deserves respect; and every challenge is an opportunity and united by empathy, we are stronger for our different perspectives. We are dedicated to building a more diverse, inclusive, and equitable workplace that supports the needs of all our employees regardless of their role, location, identity, and background.

title: Business Development Manager
description:
About Us:

Temu is seeking a highly motivated and experienced Business Development Managerto join our team. As a rapidly growing company, we are looking for talented individuals committed to helping us achieve our goals. In this role, you will have the opportunity to work with a team of driven individuals dedicated to making a difference in the industry.



Responsibilities

  • Proactively recruit and develop effective local partnerships with merchandise partners, manufacturers, and brands. Focus on categories selections to increase overall value, in alignment with business and customer needs.
  • Assist merchandise partners in establishing themselves on the platform and their growth.Guide merchandise partners in developing comprehensive plans including market positioning, product planning, brand marketing, and operational strategies.
  • Propose innovative ideas based on the current status of the categories, as well as create and implement projects through resource integration and merchant guidance.
  • Conduct industry analysis reports, explore potential customer needs through data analysis, and adjust strategies accordingly based on market trends.


Required skills / Minimum Qualifications

  • 5+ years of operational experience, including but not limited to experience in brand management or platform operations.
  • Extensive connections and relationships with local seller and vendor networks is a plus.
  • Strong data analysis skills, able to analyze industry trends and project management through data, and summarize conclusions.
  • Possesses market exploration and marketing innovation capabilities, capable of guiding overall merchant marketing plans.
  • Excellent problem-solving skills, self-motivation, ability to think strategically and adapt quickly to changes.
  • Ability to work under pressure and manage logistics during high-demand periods.


Equal Employment Statement

At Temu, we are proud to be an employer that builds a diverse community. We encourage all qualified individuals to apply and join our team. We are dedicated to providing a work environment free from discrimination and harassment, where all employees are treated with respect and dignity.


Apply today to join Temu and be part of a dynamic and innovative company.

description:
We Transform. SAP® Solutions into Value


As pessoas são e continuarão sendo uma parte importante dessa missão. Em tudo o que fazemos, nossos funcionários desempenham um papel decisivo para nossos clientes e uns para os outros. É por isso que estamos sempre em busca de profissionais experientes e em início de carreira para se juntarem à nossa equipe.


Fazemos parte do grupo NTT DATA – um dos 10 maiores provedores de tecnologia do mundo – segundo o Gartner, e juntos somos mais de 130.000 colaboradores espalhados em 53 países. Nossa meta é impactar positivamente o mundo ajudando a criar uma sociedade mais conectada, diversa e criativa.


Procuramos profissionais que também queiram impactar o mundo positivamente! Você é um deles? Se sim, cadastre-se na vaga abaixo!


Responsabilidade:

  • Consultor(a) para compor o time de AMS da NTT DATA realizando atendimento de chamados de sustentação e melhorias nos módulos MM/WM.


Requisitos:

  • Formação Superior Completo
  • Experiência como Consultor Pleno MM e WM.
  • Desejável conhecimento do EWM.
  • Experiência com implementação e/ou suporte AMS.
  • Inglês Avançado - Desejável


Formato de Trabalho: Remoto

Tipo de contrato: CLT


Garantimos que nossos funcionários sejam bem tratados, oferecendo pacotes de remuneração específicos para cada país, programas de reconhecimento e benefícios de prevenção. Dessa forma, incentivamos nossos colaboradores a terem o melhor desempenho e a comemorarem suas conquistas.


*Todas as vagas da NTT DATA são destinadas também para pessoas com deficiência.

title: Senior Full Stack Engineer
description:
For many of us, there’s that one podcast we never miss, and video content is part of our daily routine, whether it’s professional or personal. But how many of us truly understand the effort that goes on behind the scenes? Here at Riverside, we know it well. That’s exactly why we built an AI-powered platform that helps content creators, podcasters, marketeers, and more at major brands like Netflix, Disney, Google, and Microsoft to create high-quality content with ease.

Riverside’s technology streamlines the entire content creation process, turning ideas into professional-grade content with the highest production standards, without requiring expensive equipment or external services. The secret? AI-driven tools that replace traditional production roles like editing, directing, and design, automating the entire process at the click of a button.


About the Engineering Team

We’re a team of smart, curious engineers building scalable, reliable systems that power content creation for millions. We work with modern web technologies, tackle real-world challenges in distributed systems, and keep things practical-no over-engineering, just solid solutions. If you love solving tough problems, moving fast, and building tech that creators actually use, you’ll fit right in.


On your day to day

We’re looking for a Senior Full Stack Engineer (Remote) who’s passionate about technology, performance, and crafting amazing user experiences. You’ll join a global, distributed team working on the core of our platform - where most of the content of our users is being created, where stability and performance are key.


Tech Stack: TypeScript • React • Redux • Nest.js • Node.js • MongoDB • AWS


What You’ll Do:

  • Build and ship end-to-end features that power our recording & live-call experience
  • Design and maintain scalable microservices
  • Prototype quickly, iterate fast, and deliver impact
  • Collaborate with product, design & growth teams to improve UX
  • Use data to guide decisions and enhance performance

Why You’ll Love It

  • Work with a passionate, remote-first team
  • Shape the product used by thousands of creators
  • Competitive pay + flexibility + autonomy

If you love building seamless, high-performance web experiences - we’d love to meet you.


What Will Make You Stand Out?

  • Degree in Computer Science or equivalent real-world experience
  • 8+ years of software development experience
  • Deep expertise in React and JavaScript/TypeScript , applying modern best practices, design patterns, and clean code principles
  • Good experience with Node.js, MongoDB, and RESTful APIs
  • Proven experience working in remote and distributed teams
  • Excellent communication and teamwork in English
  • Bonus: Experience with Websockets, WebRTC, MediaStream, and browser APIs for audio/video

Bottom line? If you wanna take part in transforming how people and businesses share their stories globally, Riverside’s your place. The work is challenging, the culture is fast-paced, and the people are exceptionally brilliant. And if that’s not enough, we guarantee that your ideas will genuinely make an impact.

title: Consultor SAP MM/WM (AMS)
description:
We Transform. SAP® Solutions into Value


As pessoas são e continuarão sendo uma parte importante dessa missão. Em tudo o que fazemos, nossos funcionários desempenham um papel decisivo para nossos clientes e uns para os outros. É por isso que estamos sempre em busca de profissionais experientes e em início de carreira para se juntarem à nossa equipe.


Fazemos parte do grupo NTT DATA – um dos 10 maiores provedores de tecnologia do mundo – segundo o Gartner, e juntos somos mais de 130.000 colaboradores espalhados em 53 países. Nossa meta é impactar positivamente o mundo ajudando a criar uma sociedade mais conectada, diversa e criativa.


Procuramos profissionais que também queiram impactar o mundo positivamente! Você é um deles? Se sim, cadastre-se na vaga abaixo!


Responsabilidade:

  • Consultor(a) para compor o time de AMS da NTT DATA realizando atendimento de chamados de sustentação e melhorias nos módulos MM/WM.


Requisitos:

  • Formação Superior Completo
  • Experiência como Consultor Pleno MM e WM.
  • Desejável conhecimento do EWM.
  • Experiência com implementação e/ou suporte AMS.
  • Inglês Avançado - Desejável


Formato de Trabalho: Remoto

Tipo de contrato: CLT


Garantimos que nossos funcionários sejam bem tratados, oferecendo pacotes de remuneração específicos para cada país, programas de reconhecimento e benefícios de prevenção. Dessa forma, incentivamos nossos colaboradores a terem o melhor desempenho e a comemorarem suas conquistas.


*Todas as vagas da NTT DATA são destinadas também para pessoas com deficiência.

title: Analista Desenvolvedor Cobol Pleno
description:
Key Responsibilities

• Realizar manutenções e desenvolvimento de aplicações Cobol para plataformas Mainframe Unisys;

• Definição de requisitos funcionais e não funcionais;

• Definir solução técnica, fazer estimativas de esforço e prazos, assegurando a entrega dentro do cronograma estabelecido.;

• Codificar e realizar testes unitários; Atuar em colaboração com o time diariamente para avaliar progresso das atividades e avaliar riscos de projeto, promovendo uma abordagem proativa na resolução de problemas.;

• Contribuir de forma multidisciplinar com objetivo de ajudar o time a atingir as metas, participando ativamente em discussões e oferecendo suporte sempre que necessário;

• Colaborar com outros membros da equipe para promover boas práticas de desenvolvimento e manutenção de software, incentivando a inovação e aprimoramento contínuo.


Key Qualifications

• Graduação completa na área de tecnologia: Sistemas da Informação, Ciência da Computação ou áreas afins;

• Inglês intermediário para compreensão e leitura

• Conhecimento e experiencia com desenvolvimento de aplicação utilizando Cobol Conhecimento e experiencia de trabalho em equipe com métodos ágeis SCRUM ou Kanban, capacidade de adaptação a mudanças, entrega incremental e foco na qualidade e valor do produto;

• Experiência com processos da engenharia de software e desenvolvimento de sistemas, incluindo analise, design, implementação, testes e manutenção;

• Experiencia desenvolvimento ambiente mainframe Unisys, COMS, DMSII, SDF, CANDE

• Conhecimento em testes unitários e de integração automatizados (TDD/ATDD) em rotinas COBOL.

• Conhecimentos na técnica de desenvolvimento ágil BDD (Behavior Driven Development).

• Ser flexível, colaborativo e proativo;

• Empatia, capacidade de colaborar em equipe e excelente relacionamento interpessoal;

• Buscar aprendizado constantemente;

• Iniciativa, tomada de decisão e atitude de liderança, Inteligência Emocional.



Esta posição é remota, porém, caso você resida na cidade de São Paulo e regiões e esteja há 24km do escritório da Unisys (zona sul - ponte João Dias), terá vir presencial 3 vezes na semana.

title: Senior Full Stack Engineer
description:
For many of us, there’s that one podcast we never miss, and video content is part of our daily routine, whether it’s professional or personal. But how many of us truly understand the effort that goes on behind the scenes? Here at Riverside, we know it well. That’s exactly why we built an AI-powered platform that helps content creators, podcasters, marketeers, and more at major brands like Netflix, Disney, Google, and Microsoft to create high-quality content with ease.

Riverside’s technology streamlines the entire content creation process, turning ideas into professional-grade content with the highest production standards, without requiring expensive equipment or external services. The secret? AI-driven tools that replace traditional production roles like editing, directing, and design, automating the entire process at the click of a button.


About the Engineering Team

We’re a team of smart, curious engineers building scalable, reliable systems that power content creation for millions. We work with modern web technologies, tackle real-world challenges in distributed systems, and keep things practical-no over-engineering, just solid solutions. If you love solving tough problems, moving fast, and building tech that creators actually use, you’ll fit right in.


On your day to day

We’re looking for a Senior Full Stack Engineer (Remote) who’s passionate about technology, performance, and crafting amazing user experiences. You’ll join a global, distributed team working on the core of our platform - where most of the content of our users is being created, where stability and performance are key.


Tech Stack: TypeScript • React • Redux • Nest.js • Node.js • MongoDB • AWS


What You’ll Do:

  • Build and ship end-to-end features that power our recording & live-call experience
  • Design and maintain scalable microservices
  • Prototype quickly, iterate fast, and deliver impact
  • Collaborate with product, design & growth teams to improve UX
  • Use data to guide decisions and enhance performance

Why You’ll Love It

  • Work with a passionate, remote-first team
  • Shape the product used by thousands of creators
  • Competitive pay + flexibility + autonomy

If you love building seamless, high-performance web experiences - we’d love to meet you.


What Will Make You Stand Out?

  • Degree in Computer Science or equivalent real-world experience
  • 8+ years of software development experience
  • Deep expertise in React and JavaScript/TypeScript , applying modern best practices, design patterns, and clean code principles
  • Good experience with Node.js, MongoDB, and RESTful APIs
  • Proven experience working in remote and distributed teams
  • Excellent communication and teamwork in English
  • Bonus: Experience with Websockets, WebRTC, MediaStream, and browser APIs for audio/video

Bottom line? If you wanna take part in transforming how people and businesses share their stories globally, Riverside’s your place. The work is challenging, the culture is fast-paced, and the people are exceptionally brilliant. And if that’s not enough, we guarantee that your ideas will genuinely make an impact.

title: SAP Technical support leader (ABAP/BASIS)
description:
You’re purpose driven. Growth minded. Ready to stretch your potential. That’s the spirit of the community you’ll find at Orbia: where the purpose to advance life around the world drives our global team of over 23,000 every single day.

From creating solutions to deliver clean water, secure food supplies and reliable information to steering material advances that power the future of green and smart cities, transportation, and healthcare, we never settle for “good enough” when there’s an opportunity to make life better. Where purpose comes to life, it changes lives. This is what we live for.


Fluor & Energy Materials , an Orbia business, is looking for a SAP Technical support leader (ABAP/BASIS) to be based at México, Colombia or Brazil !


Job Summary/ Purpose

Our team, the Service Delivery Management for Global Applications, is responsible to ensure operational continuity of Orbia’s Global Business Applications like SAP ECC, S/4, CFIN, SuccessFactors and others. The support of these applications is under a Managed Service partner, and our role is to supervise and ensure that this service is delivered to Orbia’s standards of quality and following our processes and policies. This role will have a specific responsibility over initiatives that require Developments in those applications, by supporting and monitoring the service of the AMS (Application Managed Support) partners, defining and enforcing best practices and security standards, and providing operational support when needed (e.g. in case of escalations, issues with in-house developed apps or legacy apps).


Main Responsibilities

  • Creation of best practices and operational processes related to Application Development in SAP ECC and S/4 (ABAP, BTP, Fiori).
  • On a general note and not restricted to Development initiatives: Being a point of contact for Orbia’s companies located in LATAM, guiding them through our Service Delivery Model when needed and ensuring that they get the right support on time.
  • Provide operational support (in collaboration with the AMS partner) to application/integrations developed in-house or other developments in Legacy Applications when needed. Provide ideas to the Application Solution leads for those Legacy apps/integrations to be included the target architecture roadmap. Support their transition to target architecture when needed (e.g. from a local application to S/4 BTP portals or apps).
  • Ensure that developments or customizations in the S/4 applications are done following the Digital Decoupling strategy as defined by the Orbia Global Applications team.
  • Support and drive automation initiatives where possible, with a final goal of incident reduction and self-service (e.g. self-healing, monitoring and alert systems, automation of standard requests, etc.).
  • Drive and encourage new ways of working in collaboration with the AMS partner, for example Devops or Scrum.
  • Participation in the major incident process when needed, for Americas’ applications/time zones.
  • Participation in CAB or coordination with IT Service Desk meetings when needed.


Minimum Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in computer science or related
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English and Spanish.


Knowledge/ Experience Required

  • Good understanding of SAP ECC and S/4 Technical and Development functionalities (BTP, Basis, ABAP, Fiori/JAVA, etc.).
  • Good knowledge of ITIL framework.
  • Ability to take on the above-mentioned responsibilities with a constructive and collaborative approach.
  • Passion for Service standardization and improvement.
  • Excellent people skills, ability to manage escalations from business colleagues from all levels of the organization.
  • Able to work under pressure and meet deadlines when needed.
  • Able to manage and prioritize tasks and time efficiently, and coordinate efforts with external partners in an effective manner.
  • Able to demonstrate initiative and a proactive approach to daily tasks.


Behaviors that can help you succeed at Orbia:

  • Develop yourself & Others
  • Foster Collaboration & Inclusion
  • Drive Results
  • Provide Vision & Direction


We welcome purpose-driven dreamers, doers, and builders, recognizing that it takes difference to make a difference. If you’re ready to bring your skills, talents, and perspective to moving your career, the company, people, and the planet forward, we’d like to hear from you.

We believe that every voice matters; every community deserves respect; and every challenge is an opportunity and united by empathy, we are stronger for our different perspectives. We are dedicated to building a more diverse, inclusive, and equitable workplace that supports the needs of all our employees regardless of their role, location, identity, and background.

title: Deployment Reliability Engineer
description:
Your role and responsabilities:


  • Manage continuous delivery and configuration of SAP Ariba Cloud products using modern deployment tools.
  • Respond quickly to deployment requests and provide technical support for the SAP Ariba suite.
  • Collaborate with engineering subject matter experts to ensure seamless operations.
  • Handle user tickets and change requests within defined SLAs.
  • Automate manual tasks to improve scalability and efficiency.
  • Lead complex deployment projects including new site setups and disaster recovery planning.
  • Manage certificate renewals and troubleshoot related issues.
  • Document SOPs and apply ITIL best practices.


Requiriments and Qualifications:


  • Experience in a Unix/Linux environment.
  • Familiar with SAP Ariba Cloud products
  • Proven experience in 24x7 enterprise environments.
  • Hands-on expertise with cloud provisioning (preferably GCP and AWS).
  • Proficiency in Terraform and CI/CD tools like Jenkins, Artifactory, Docker, Vault.
  • Development experience in Python, Go, or Groovy.
  • Strong knowledge of system applications (Apache, DNS, SSH, TCP/IP, NFS).
  • Deep understanding of OS internals and file system structures.
  • Experience with certificate management and scripting (Perl, Python, Shell).
  • Basic knowledge of HANA database administration.
  • Excellent communication, analytical, and multitasking skills.
  • Bachelor’s degree in MIS, CS, or equivalent experience.
  • Advanced English

Sobre a Empresa

A Asenium Brasil procura para um profissional qualificado para integrar nossa equipe e atuar no desenvolvimento e otimização de processos críticos de armazenagem, picking, expedição e transportes (WMS e TMS ).

Descrição da Vaga

O profissional será responsável por desenvolver e aprimorar soluções ABAP nos módulos SAP EWM e TM, visando a automação e melhoria contínua dos processos logísticos da empresa.

Requisitos

  • Formação Acadêmica : Graduação em Tecnologia, Administração, Logística, Engenharia ou áreas afins.


Experiência :

  • Pelo menos 5 anos de experiência com desenvolvimento ABAP.
  • Vivência em projetos de implementação e suporte dos módulos SAP EWM (Extended Warehouse Management) e TM (Transportation Management).


Competências Técnicas

  • Proficiência em ABAP (ECC, EWM, TM, S/4HANA), incluindo CDS, BOPF e AMDP.
  • Experiência em integração de sistemas, como SAP Gateway, OData, REST APIs, IDoc, entre outros.
  • Conhecimento profundo dos módulos MM, SD e EWM, com foco em processos logísticos e cadeia de suprimentos.


O que oferecemos

  • Ambiente dinâmico e desafiador.
  • Oportunidade de trabalhar com tecnologias de ponta e contribuir para a melhoria dos processos logísticos.
  • Flexibilidade de trabalho híbrido/remoto.


Como se candidatar

Se você tem o perfil que estamos procurando, envie seu currículo para nós através do botão de candidatura!

title: Video Editor
description:
We are…

A leading digital media and content production group with a large global presence. At EMP, we believe in the power of content to unite and inspire people. With our innovative approach and content-first mentality, we're redefining how content is consumed and shared. We help create content at the highest level including some of the biggest professional athlete led podcasts in the world.


Like all winning teams, we value respect, creativity, and fun. We operate in a dynamic environment where collaboration drives ideation and where you will help shape the ever-growing sports media landscape as we know it. Here at EMP, we provide an opportunity for your voice to be heard and create a space where you can have fun in the process. We’re not just about work, rather we look to build a community that celebrates victories, learns from hardships, and grows as one. EMP is a place where your talent can shine while you make a real impact along the way.


You Are...

An experienced and driven video editor professional with experience producing quality video edits, ideally within the media, entertainment, or sports industry. You are passionate about growth, entrepreneurial in spirit, and able to work in collaboration with a team

You Will...

  • Edit audio and video for podcast, YouTube videos, advertisments, branded content, and more to create high-quality, color corrected, synchronized video content.
  • Ensure audio clarity, correct sync issues, and enhance sound quality with noise reduction, EQ, and other techniques.
  • Add intro/outro music, sound effects, and transitions for a professional and polished final product.
  • Select impactful or interesting moments from episodes to create shorter video clips for social media platforms (e.g., Instagram, YouTube, TikTok).
  • Tailor clips for specific platform requirements (aspect ratios, length, captioning) and audience engagement.
  • Add dynamic motion graphics, lower thirds, captions, and animations to enhance viewer experience.
  • Create and integrate title cards, branding elements, and background visuals in alignment with the podcast’s visual identity
  • Work closely with hosts, producers, and social media managers to align on styles, themes, key messages, and desired tone
  • and more...


Job Requirements

You Have...

  • The ability to speak advanced to fluent English
  • Minimum 2-3 years of experience in video editing, preferably with podcast or interview-style content.
  • Skills Adobe Premiere Pro, Final Cut Pro, or similar video editing software; familiarity with audio software (e.g., Audacity, Adobe Audition) is a plus.
  • Strong understanding of sound design, color correction, and high level motion graphics/animations.
  • Excellent attention to detail and quality control in all aspects of editing.
  • Strong communication skills and ability to collaborate effectively with multiple teams.
  • Ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously and meet deadlines.
  • Demonstrated experience through a portfolio of video editing work.

Aqui na TCS acreditamos que as pessoas fazem a diferença, por isso vivemos uma cultura de aprendizado ilimitado cheio de oportunidades de melhorias e desenvolvimento mútuo. O cenário ideal para expandir ideias através das ferramentas certas, contribuindo para nosso sucesso num ambiente colaborativo.


Sobre o Papel:

Procuramos Analista de Processos Sênior que queira aprender e transformar sua carreira.


Principais Responsabilidades:


●Diagnóstico e Mapeamento (As-Is): Conduzir entrevistas, workshops e sessões de observação com stakeholders para um levantamento detalhado dos processos atuais.

●Análise Crítica: Analisar os processos mapeados para identificar gargalos, restrições, dependências, ineficiências, redundâncias, retrabalho e pontos de falha que impactam a performance e a qualidade.

●Investigação de Causa Raiz: Aplicar técnicas estruturadas (como Diagrama de Ishikawa, 5 Porquês) para diagnosticar a origem dos problemas identificados, indo além dos sintomas.

●Desenho e Modelagem (To-Be): Projetar processos futuros, otimizados e alinhados às melhores práticas, utilizando notações padrão de mercado (ex: BPMN) para garantir clareza e consistência.

●Definição e Validação: Definir o escopo, os objetivos e as métricas de sucesso para iniciativas de melhoria, validando as soluções propostas com as áreas de negócio e garantindo o alinhamento estratégico.

●Documentação e Gestão do Conhecimento: Criar e manter a documentação técnica dos processos, incluindo fluxogramas, manuais, e regras de negócio, servindo como uma base de conhecimento para a organização.


Competências Técnicas :


●Domínio de BPM: Sólida experiência com as práticas e disciplinas do BPM (Business Process Management), tendo como referência o guia BPM CBOK.

●Técnicas de Levantamento: Proficiência em conduzir entrevistas, observar operações e facilitar workshops para coletar requisitos e mapear processos de forma precisa.

●Análise de Processos: Habilidade comprovada para analisar fluxos de trabalho, identificando dores, problemas de qualidade, riscos, não conformidades e oportunidades de melhoria.

●Modelagem de Processos: Experiência prática na criação de diagramas de processo (fluxogramas) e na documentação de atividades, tarefas e pontos de decisão.

●Resolução de Problemas: Capacidade de questionar e investigar as razões por trás de atrasos e ineficiências, aplicando uma abordagem analítica e estruturada.


Certificações (Desejável):

Certificação relevante na área, como CBPP® (Certified Business Process Professional) da ABPMP, ou similar.


Diferenciais:

●Experiência do Usuário: Vivência com metodologias de Design Thinking e desenho de jornada do usuário para criar processos centrados nas necessidades do cliente e do colaborador.

●Arquitetura de Negócios: Conhecimento em frameworks como TOGAF ou BIZBOK (BA GUILD) para garantir o alinhamento dos processos com a estratégia corporativa.

●Arquitetura e Modelagem de Dados: Noções de Análise e Modelagem Conceitual de Dados, tendo como referência o DAMA DMBOK, para entender como os dados suportam e são gerados pelos processos.


Formação: Superior em Administração, Ciência da Computação, Sistemas de Informação, Engenharia de Software ou áreas correlatas..


Pós-Graduação/Certificação Avançada: Pelo menos uma pós-graduação, MBA ou uma certificação avançada (ex: Black Belt em Lean Six Sigma, certificações avançadas em Arquitetura de Negócios ou Processos).


Idiomas: Inglês avançado ou fluente para colaboração com equipes globais.


O que você pode esperar de nós?

  • Desenvolvimento profissional e evolução constante das suas competências, sempre de acordo com os seus interesses.
  • Oportunidades para trabalho fora do Brasil
  • Um ambiente colaborativo, diverso e inovador, que incentiva o trabalho em equipe.

O que oferecemos?

  • Benefícios TCS – Brasil
  • Plano de Saúde
  • Planos Odontológico
  • Seguro de Vida
  • Vale Transporte
  • Vale Refeição/Alimentação
  • Auxílio Creche

  • Parceria com SESC
  • Reembolso de Certificações
  • Portal de aprendizagem gratuito da TCS – cursos online e treinamentos ao vivo
  • Oportunidade de experiência internacional
  • Parceria de Descontos com Universidades e Escolas de Idiomas
  • Bring Your Buddy – Ao indicar pessoas você se torna elegível a receber um bônus para cada contratação
  • TCS Gems – Reconhecimento por performance
  • Xcelerate – Plataforma de carreira com mentoria gratuita

title: Consultor SAP ABAP
description:
Vaga: Analista de Sistemas Sênior ABAP

Localização : São Paulo / SP (Híbrido / Remoto) | Regime de Contratação : PJ

Sobre a Empresa

A Asenium Brasil procura para um profissional qualificado para integrar nossa equipe e atuar no desenvolvimento e otimização de processos críticos de armazenagem, picking, expedição e transportes (WMS e TMS ).

Descrição da Vaga

O profissional será responsável por desenvolver e aprimorar soluções ABAP nos módulos SAP EWM e TM, visando a automação e melhoria contínua dos processos logísticos da empresa.

Requisitos

  • Formação Acadêmica : Graduação em Tecnologia, Administração, Logística, Engenharia ou áreas afins.


Experiência :

  • Pelo menos 5 anos de experiência com desenvolvimento ABAP.
  • Vivência em projetos de implementação e suporte dos módulos SAP EWM (Extended Warehouse Management) e TM (Transportation Management).


Competências Técnicas

  • Proficiência em ABAP (ECC, EWM, TM, S/4HANA), incluindo CDS, BOPF e AMDP.
  • Experiência em integração de sistemas, como SAP Gateway, OData, REST APIs, IDoc, entre outros.
  • Conhecimento profundo dos módulos MM, SD e EWM, com foco em processos logísticos e cadeia de suprimentos.


O que oferecemos

  • Ambiente dinâmico e desafiador.
  • Oportunidade de trabalhar com tecnologias de ponta e contribuir para a melhoria dos processos logísticos.
  • Flexibilidade de trabalho híbrido/remoto.


Como se candidatar

Se você tem o perfil que estamos procurando, envie seu currículo para nós através do botão de candidatura!

title: Deployment Reliability Engineer
description:
Your role and responsabilities:


  • Manage continuous delivery and configuration of SAP Ariba Cloud products using modern deployment tools.
  • Respond quickly to deployment requests and provide technical support for the SAP Ariba suite.
  • Collaborate with engineering subject matter experts to ensure seamless operations.
  • Handle user tickets and change requests within defined SLAs.
  • Automate manual tasks to improve scalability and efficiency.
  • Lead complex deployment projects including new site setups and disaster recovery planning.
  • Manage certificate renewals and troubleshoot related issues.
  • Document SOPs and apply ITIL best practices.


Requiriments and Qualifications:


  • Experience in a Unix/Linux environment.
  • Familiar with SAP Ariba Cloud products
  • Proven experience in 24x7 enterprise environments.
  • Hands-on expertise with cloud provisioning (preferably GCP and AWS).
  • Proficiency in Terraform and CI/CD tools like Jenkins, Artifactory, Docker, Vault.
  • Development experience in Python, Go, or Groovy.
  • Strong knowledge of system applications (Apache, DNS, SSH, TCP/IP, NFS).
  • Deep understanding of OS internals and file system structures.
  • Experience with certificate management and scripting (Perl, Python, Shell).
  • Basic knowledge of HANA database administration.
  • Excellent communication, analytical, and multitasking skills.
  • Bachelor’s degree in MIS, CS, or equivalent experience.
  • Advanced English


Please submit resumé in English

title: Video Editor
description:
We are…

A leading digital media and content production group with a large global presence. At EMP, we believe in the power of content to unite and inspire people. With our innovative approach and content-first mentality, we're redefining how content is consumed and shared. We help create content at the highest level including some of the biggest professional athlete led podcasts in the world.


Like all winning teams, we value respect, creativity, and fun. We operate in a dynamic environment where collaboration drives ideation and where you will help shape the ever-growing sports media landscape as we know it. Here at EMP, we provide an opportunity for your voice to be heard and create a space where you can have fun in the process. We’re not just about work, rather we look to build a community that celebrates victories, learns from hardships, and grows as one. EMP is a place where your talent can shine while you make a real impact along the way.


You Are...

An experienced and driven video editor professional with experience producing quality video edits, ideally within the media, entertainment, or sports industry. You are passionate about growth, entrepreneurial in spirit, and able to work in collaboration with a team

You Will...

  • Edit audio and video for podcast, YouTube videos, advertisments, branded content, and more to create high-quality, color corrected, synchronized video content.
  • Ensure audio clarity, correct sync issues, and enhance sound quality with noise reduction, EQ, and other techniques.
  • Add intro/outro music, sound effects, and transitions for a professional and polished final product.
  • Select impactful or interesting moments from episodes to create shorter video clips for social media platforms (e.g., Instagram, YouTube, TikTok).
  • Tailor clips for specific platform requirements (aspect ratios, length, captioning) and audience engagement.
  • Add dynamic motion graphics, lower thirds, captions, and animations to enhance viewer experience.
  • Create and integrate title cards, branding elements, and background visuals in alignment with the podcast’s visual identity
  • Work closely with hosts, producers, and social media managers to align on styles, themes, key messages, and desired tone
  • and more...


Job Requirements

You Have...

  • The ability to speak advanced to fluent English
  • Minimum 2-3 years of experience in video editing, preferably with podcast or interview-style content.
  • Skills Adobe Premiere Pro, Final Cut Pro, or similar video editing software; familiarity with audio software (e.g., Audacity, Adobe Audition) is a plus.
  • Strong understanding of sound design, color correction, and high level motion graphics/animations.
  • Excellent attention to detail and quality control in all aspects of editing.
  • Strong communication skills and ability to collaborate effectively with multiple teams.
  • Ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously and meet deadlines.
  • Demonstrated experience through a portfolio of video editing work.

title: Senior Data Architect - Databricks (Remote)
description:
Olá!

A Aggrandize nasceu em 2015 com a missão de engrandecer pessoas e negócios . Guiados por valores como adaptabilidade, colaboração, foco no cliente e visão de dono, oferecemos soluções que transformam desafios em oportunidades.


Somos especialistas em Platform Engineering , Data Analytics , Modern Applications e Cybersecurity , sempre com o compromisso de impulsionar o crescimento e a inovação de nossos parceiros.


Nosso trabalho é mais do que tecnologia; é sobre potencializar resultados. Increase the power of your business .


Agora que você conhece a cultura Aggrandize, saiba mais sobre a oportunidade:


❇️ O seu papel no time:

  • Projetar e implementar arquiteturas de dados escaláveis e modernas (Lakehouse, Delta Lake, Medallion).
  • Colaborar com equipes de negócio e tecnologia para alinhar soluções aos objetivos estratégicos.
  • Liderar iniciativas de modernização e descentralização de dados com abordagem Data Mesh.
  • Garantir governança, segurança e compliance (LGPD, IAM, RBAC).
  • Participar ativamente do planejamento estratégico de dados, alinhando soluções às metas corporativas.
  • Apoiar a definição de roadmaps de dados e contribuir com decisões arquiteturais de longo prazo.
  • Realizar alinhamentos regulares com stakeholders técnicos e de negócio para garantir aderência às necessidades organizacionais.


❇️ O que esperamos de você - Hard Skills:

  • Experiência sólida em Azure: Data Lake Gen2, Databricks (Delta Lake), Synapse, Unity Catalog.
  • Domínio em Python e SQL para ETL/ELT em larga escala.
  • Vivência com arquitetura Data Mesh e descentralização de domínios de dados.
  • Conhecimento em governança e segurança de dados.
  • Experiência com modelagem de dados e processamento batch/streaming.
  • Desenvolver pipelines de dados com Databricks, Azure Data Factory e Synapse.
  • Aplicar práticas de DataOps e CI/CD com GitHub/Azure DevOps.


❇️ Diferencial:

  • Experiência com Google Cloud Platform (BigQuery, Vertex AI, Dataflow).
  • Vivência em ambientes multi-cloud (Azure, AWS, GCP).
  • Certificações em Azure ou GCP.
  • Conhecimento em ferramentas como MLflow, Spark, Airflow.
  • Integrar soluções de machine learning com Vertex AI e pipelines analíticos com BigQuery.


❇️ O que esperamos de você - Soft Skills:

  • Visão estratégica e foco em valor de negócio.
  • Boa comunicação com stakeholders técnicos e executivos.
  • Proatividade e autonomia na condução de projetos.
  • Colaboração com times multidisciplinares.


✨O que oferecemos (modalidade CLT):

  • VR/VA de R$38/dia (cartão flexível);
  • Auxílio flex de R$210/mês (cartão flexível);
  • TotalPass;
  • Plano de saúde e odontológico;
  • Seguro de vida;
  • PLR;
  • Day off de aniversário;
  • Treinamentos e certificações custeadas pela Aggrandize;
  • Programa de indicação premiada.

title: Video Editor
description:
We are…

A leading digital media and content production group with a large global presence. At EMP, we believe in the power of content to unite and inspire people. With our innovative approach and content-first mentality, we're redefining how content is consumed and shared. We help create content at the highest level including some of the biggest professional athlete led podcasts in the world.


Like all winning teams, we value respect, creativity, and fun. We operate in a dynamic environment where collaboration drives ideation and where you will help shape the ever-growing sports media landscape as we know it. Here at EMP, we provide an opportunity for your voice to be heard and create a space where you can have fun in the process. We’re not just about work, rather we look to build a community that celebrates victories, learns from hardships, and grows as one. EMP is a place where your talent can shine while you make a real impact along the way.


You Are...

An experienced and driven video editor professional with experience producing quality video edits, ideally within the media, entertainment, or sports industry. You are passionate about growth, entrepreneurial in spirit, and able to work in collaboration with a team

You Will...

  • Edit audio and video for podcast, YouTube videos, advertisments, branded content, and more to create high-quality, color corrected, synchronized video content.
  • Ensure audio clarity, correct sync issues, and enhance sound quality with noise reduction, EQ, and other techniques.
  • Add intro/outro music, sound effects, and transitions for a professional and polished final product.
  • Select impactful or interesting moments from episodes to create shorter video clips for social media platforms (e.g., Instagram, YouTube, TikTok).
  • Tailor clips for specific platform requirements (aspect ratios, length, captioning) and audience engagement.
  • Add dynamic motion graphics, lower thirds, captions, and animations to enhance viewer experience.
  • Create and integrate title cards, branding elements, and background visuals in alignment with the podcast’s visual identity
  • Work closely with hosts, producers, and social media managers to align on styles, themes, key messages, and desired tone
  • and more...


Job Requirements

You Have...

  • The ability to speak advanced to fluent English
  • Minimum 2-3 years of experience in video editing, preferably with podcast or interview-style content.
  • Skills Adobe Premiere Pro, Final Cut Pro, or similar video editing software; familiarity with audio software (e.g., Audacity, Adobe Audition) is a plus.
  • Strong understanding of sound design, color correction, and high level motion graphics/animations.
  • Excellent attention to detail and quality control in all aspects of editing.
  • Strong communication skills and ability to collaborate effectively with multiple teams.
  • Ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously and meet deadlines.
  • Demonstrated experience through a portfolio of video editing work.
